title: Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro robot vacuum launch: Features, price, where to buy
excerpt: Your floors are about to have a better routine than you do.
content_html:
TL;DR: Roborock has launched the Qrevo 2 Pro in the UK with a limited-time launch discount. Right now it's available for £529.99 (£120 off its £649.99 list price) through Aug. 9 at Amazon UK and Roborock's official store.

Credit: Roborock

£529.99 at Amazon UK
£649.99 Save £120

Roborock's Qrevo 2 Pro robot vacuum just launched in the UK with a limited-time deal — until Aug. 9, it's £529.99 (£120 off its £649.99 list price) with Amazon UK and Roborock's official store.

The Qrevo 2 Pro runs on 25,000 Pa HyperForce suction, strong enough to lift embedded dirt from hard floors and automatically ramps up power when it hits a carpet. If you've got pets, the Dual Anti-Tangle System pairs a rubber-and-bristle main brush with a side brush that guides hair inward instead of letting it wrap around the roller, which Roborock says results in zero tangling and full hair pickup.

Credit: Roborock

It's also designed for homes with mixed flooring. There's an Auto Mop Removal feature that detaches the mop pad before it hits carpet and reattaches once it's back on hard floors, so you don't end up with damp carpet spots. The side brush reverses direction in corners to sweep more thoroughly, covering up to 30% more corner area, and the mop can extend to within 1.85mm of the wall for full edge coverage.

As for maintenance, the dock is designed to take most of it off your hands. It self-cleans the mop with 75°C hot water, dries it with warm air, refills the water tank automatically, and can go up to 65 days without needing the dust bin emptied manually. The whole system runs on Roborock's SmartPlan 3.0, which learns your home's layout and floor types over time and adjusts its cleaning approach accordingly.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR：Roborock 在英国推出了 Qrevo 2 Pro，并提供限时折扣。 目前该产品的售价为 529.99 英镑（比 649.99 英镑标价低 120 英镑），截止日期为 8 月 9 日，在英国亚马逊和 Roborock 官方商店有售。

图片来源：Roborock

英国亚马逊 £529.99 £649.99 节省 £120

Roborock 的 Qrevo 2 Pro 扫地机器人刚刚在英国推出，并在 8 月 9 日之前在英国亚马逊和 Roborock 官方商店限时优惠，售价为 529.99 英镑（比 649.99 英镑标价低 120 英镑）。

Qrevo 2 Pro 采用 25,000 Pa HyperForce 吸力，吸力强劲，足以吸走硬地板上嵌入的污垢，并在碰到地毯时自动增强功率。 如果你有宠物，双重防缠结系统将橡胶和鬃毛主刷与侧刷配对，将毛发向内引导，而不是让毛发缠绕在滚筒上，Roborock 表示，这可以实现零缠结和完整的毛发拾取。

图片来源：Roborock

它也专为混合地板的家庭而设计。 有一个自动拖把拆卸功能，可以在拖把垫碰到地毯之前将其拆下，并在回到硬地板上后重新连接，这样您就不会留下潮湿的地毯斑点。 边刷在角落处反转方向，扫得更彻底，可覆盖最多 30% 的角落区域，拖把可延伸至距离墙壁 1.85 毫米以内，实现完整边缘覆盖。

至于维护，该扩展坞的设计目的是让您摆脱大部分维护工作。 它可以用 75°C 热水自动清洁拖把，用暖风烘干，自动给水箱补充水，可持续使用长达 65 天，无需手动清空垃圾箱。 整个系统在 Roborock 的 SmartPlan 3.0 上运行，它会随着时间的推移了解您家的布局和地板类型，并相应地调整其清洁方法。
